run_SPMDWorker: run a Ray remote SPMDWorker actor that initializes distributed setup and executes a Runner payload
create_SPMDController: create an SPMDController to launch SPMDWorker actors across placement groups on a Ray cluster
review_SPMDWorker_distributed_setup: review the SPMDWorker _distributed_setup method that initializes torch process groups with nccl or gloo backend
run_ray_entrypoint: run the ray_entrypoint function that instantiates and executes a Runner from a Hydra config
launch_ray_on_slurm: launch a Ray cluster on Slurm nodes using ray_on_slurm_launch with scheduler and Slurm config
